info.name: A Chat with Nara the Tour Guide

descriptions.inProgress: Nara said a Ripped VIP pass will not work, nor can it be re-published, but the way to leave may be easier by paying a visit to Shuri, the tour guide at Orbis.
descriptions.completed: Hmmm ... so something as simple as making a new ticket cannot be done, huh. Alright, since I'm here and all, why don't I just take a crack at it til the very end?
